title: Telemetry-aware role assignment UX for RBAC v2
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a role assignment and editor experience for RBAC v2 that surfaces telemetry and audit signals to help admins make safer membership decisions. The goal is a compact panel for adding members, a suggestion engine for roles based on recent activity, inline audit log excerpts, and clear footnotes for SSO/SAML-mapped group rules and inherited permissions. Focus on reducing mistaken over-permissioning and supporting bulk actions while preserving clarity for tenant admins and delegated role managers.
acceptance_criteria: New role assignment panel implements telemetry badges showing recent token usage (last 7d/30d) and high-risk actions observed
Inline audit snippets available for the top 3 prior role changes for the selected user
SSO group mapping and eligibility state shown when assigning users who originate from SAML/SCIM providers
Bulk invite flow includes a preview of resultant permission deltas and explicit opt-in for permission escalation
Design handoff includes annotated Figma frames, accessibility notes (contrast, keyboard flow), and a small interaction spec for canary rollout
Design validated with 3 customer-facing PM/SE feedback sessions and updated per feedback
decisions: Show telemetry as three-band micro-badges: Active (7d), Recent (30d), Dormant (90d)
Inline audit excerpts limited to 3 most recent changes to keep surface area minimal
When SSO group mapping exists, show 'Managed by SSO' pill and disable direct role edits for mapped attributes; provide link to identity provider mappings page
Bulk assignment preview will compute permission deltas and flag any 'escalation' where a user gains higher privilege than any existing role on the tenant
next_steps: Prototype keyboard and screen-reader flows for the panel (Design)
Align with ENG on the telemetry API contract: endpoints, pagination, and cache expectations
Schedule customer validation sessions with 2 enterprise customers and 1 startup seat
Create QA checklist items for audit snippet integrity and SAML mapping edge cases
